summary.text: Michael Hale is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 40, where he has served since November 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Hale is on the ballot with Daniel Hawthorne.

paragraphs.text: Michael Hale graduated from DeKalb County High School and earned an associate degree from John A. Gupton Mortuary College.
His career experience includes owning DeKalb Funeral Chapel and working as a farmer.
Hale has been affiliated with the Tennessee Funeral Directors Association, the Smithville-DeKalb County Chamber of Commerce, and the Tennessee and American Simmental Association.
Hale took office representing District 40 on November 8, 2022.
In the 2023–2024 session he was assigned to the Commerce and Local Government committees.
